obs.frame: rows 0-48 are the first-person view (64 wide), rows 49-62 the Craftax inventory strip (63 wide, byte-identical to craftax_classic), row 63 black padding

human.controls: Arrows move and face in WORLD directions (not relative to the camera) - the camera snaps to the way you face. SPACE interacts with the cell ahead. TAB sleeps. 1-4 place stone/table/furnace/sapling. 5-7 craft pickaxes, 8-9-0 craft swords (stand next to a table; iron needs a furnace too).

reference.name: craftax_classic (this repo) + PufferLib craftax_classic 6ffa5b1 dynamics
reference.parity: dynamics are craftax_classic's, unchanged and reused by manifest path: the same source files produce the same 6880-byte canonical state every step, which is what tests/test_same_dynamics.py asserts over the whole corpus
not_matched: observation is first-person; not Craftax-Classic-Pixels, and there is no first-person Craftax to be exact against. This is a VARIANT of Craftax-Classic - same task, different observation function - and must never be described as Craftax parity
everything craftax_classic does not match, inherited unchanged: auto-reset RNG continuation across episodes, and the one NOOP the host reset consumes before the first agent action
